narrative: Material PL1__MC0A352A exhibits smooth demand behavior with CV=0.175 and is best modeled using a normal distribution. Mean daily demand is 3922.17 units with standard deviation 686.26. Lead time analysis reveals unstable performance (CV=0.665), with mean lead time of 1.46 days. The high lead time variability drives a recommended safety stock of 6403 units to achieve 95% service level. The optimized (r,Q) policy recommends Safety Stock=6403 units (vs SAP: 90), Order Quantity=11954 units, Reorder Point=12123 units, and Review Period=4 days. The EOQ-based order quantity balances ordering costs ($50.0) against holding costs ($0.69/unit/year). Storage capacity constraint (36932 units) is satisfied with a comfortable 49.8% utilization margin.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Given smooth demand (CV=0.175) and normal distribution, the classical (r,Q) EOQ model with normal approximation for safety stock is the appropriate and analytically tractable choice for this high-volume, regular-demand material.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Lead time variability is high (CV=0.665, classified unstable), which increases replenishment timing uncertainty and drives the safety stock requirement to 6403 units. Supplier lead time improvement targeting CV<0.4 would reduce safety stock by approximately 30% and generate meaningful holding cost savings.
research_insights.escalation_flag: None — capacity constraint is non-binding. MOQ + safety_stock = 8,471 units, well within max_storage_units = 36,932 units.
